title: showreel: headlines fit a portrait frame, a platform safe zone, and a handle that fits at 16:9
objective: At portrait a headline fits the frame's width instead of breaking mid-word or running off it, a recording can be made inside TikTok's and Instagram's safe zone so their own UI covers nothing that matters, and a socials handle that overflows at 16:9 is fitted there too. Widescreen without a zone records byte for byte as it does now (design.md).
context:
hv, 2026-09-22, through vc: yes to all three of the portrait calls left open when ST0023 closed. 6.1 headline fit-to-width at portrait in general, geodica's ask, scoped out of ST0023 and carried on vc's board as todo 27. 6.2 a platform safe-zone option for TikTok and Instagram, whose own UI covers the bottom of the frame and the right edge, with the corner mark, the venue labels and the at-work QR moved inside it. 6.3 a socials handle that overflows at 16:9 is fitted there too, which ST0023 D3 deliberately left alone.

It is the day's critical path: the release that carries it is 2.12.0, cut today through devbin's release core.

Roles: cc builds, vc reviews and verifies, hv rules.
